exclusivity.heading: One agent per suburb. No exceptions.
exclusivity.body: Once your suburb is claimed, it's locked. Every reel, every ad, every dollar of attention we earn in your patch goes to you and only you.

steps.title: We pull up your suburb.
steps.body: Who's posting, who's winning attention, and where the gap is. Real data on your patch, not a generic deck.

steps.title: We show you the system in your suburb.
steps.body: What the content, social and ads would look like for your area specifically, and what it's done in suburbs like yours.

steps.title: We tell you straight.
steps.body: If it's a fit, you'll know the next step. If it's not, we'll say so and you keep the audit. Either way, 15 minutes and you walk away knowing exactly where you stand in your suburb.

items.q: What if my suburb is already taken?
items.a: Two options. We add you to the waitlist for that suburb, or we find a high-potential suburb nearby that's still open. You keep the free audit either way.

items.q: I've been burnt by agencies before. Why is this different?
items.a: Most agencies have never sat an open home or lost a listing to the agent down the road. Blake was an agent for 4 years, was featured on national news, and has produced 3,000+ videos since. And because we only take one agent per suburb, we can't hedge our bets across your competitors. If you don't win your patch, we don't have a story to tell. That's the difference.

items.q: Do I need to be on camera?
items.a: Yes. People list with people, not logos. Don't worry about being polished, we coach you through what to say and how to say it. Most agents are comfortable by their second shoot.

items.q: How long does it take to see results?
items.a: Profile growth is immediate. Lead enquiries usually start in weeks 3-6 once ads have data. Listings typically follow in months 2-4. This is a compounding system, not a vending machine.

items.q: I'm in Australia. Do you operate here?
items.a: Yes. We work across NZ and Australia. Brisbane, Sydney, Melbourne, Gold Coast, Auckland, Wellington and beyond. If you've got a suburb, we can shoot it.

finalCta.heading: Ready to own your suburb?
finalCta.body: Book a free 15-min call. We'll check your suburb is still open, audit your area, show you what's possible, and tell you straight whether we're a fit. No pitch deck. No pressure.
